blockers.criterion: AC1: The project settings screen shows review.maxLoops with its current value and the default 2.
blockers.reason: With review.maxLoops set to 3 (or 0), the form fills the input and displays Current: 3 (or 0). The default 2 appears only in the input placeholder, which is hidden when the input has a value; Use default does not name the value either. Render the project form with a configured limit of 3 and verify that both current 3 and default 2 are visibly displayed without clearing the field.

missingTests.criterion: AC5: With the run option empty, a run started through the server API uses the file value.
missingTests.reason: The server integration test in web/test/review-loop-limit.test.ts parameterizes only the explicit override 5. Neither it nor test/config/review-loop-limit.test.ts exercises an empty override. Add an API start case with a committed project maxLoops of 1 and env.SDLC_REVIEW_MAX_LOOPS set to an empty string; verify the child resolves 1 and the project config bytes remain unchanged. Commit the fixture config before starting so this tests fallback independently of the excluded uncommitted-settings/worktree issue.
